title: False Colours
intro_lines: A brig flies UTC ensigns but handles like a privateer.
Gunports stay shut.
They signal: "Heave to for inspection."

choices.label: Run the black flag up early

outcomes.text: They hesitate, then sheer off — reputation precedes you.
They open fire anyway — a test. Splinters rake the palisade.
A lucky shot cuts your flag halyard. They close fast.

choices.label: Feign compliance, prepare ambush

outcomes.text: Your gunners wait. At point-blank, grapeshot clears their deck.
They suspect a trap. Boarding nets fly. Brutal melee ensues.
Your powder is damp. Misfires. They swarm the breach laughing.

choices.label: Send Tide-Puck to sabotage their anchor

outcomes.text: The beast gnaws the cable. They drift onto the reef, holed.
A sentry spots it. Crossbow bolt wounds Tide-Puck.
It dives too deep, tangles in kelp. Returns empty-jawed.

history_note: Pirates routinely flew false flags — friendly colours until close range — to lure merchants into striking without a fight (Johnson 1724).

title: Muffled Oars
intro_lines: Moonless night.
The surf masks the thup-thup of oars.
Dark shapes glide through the reef channel — longboats.

choices.label: Light the signal fires, rally

outcomes.text: Flames bloom. Pirates hesitate, silhouetted. Volley fire breaks them.
They've grappling hooks. First rank gains the wall. Desperate fighting.
Wet powder. Misfires. They pour over the logs laughing.

choices.label: Slip into the jungle, harass

outcomes.text: Guerrilla arrows and Tide-Puck's ambushes bleed them. They withdraw.
A pirate veteran tracks you. Cutlass slash across the ribs.
You lose them in the dark, but they torch the storehouse.

choices.label: Negotiate — offer tribute for departure

outcomes.text: Their quartermaster accepts. They row off, honouring the bargain.
They take the goods and a hostage — your carpenter.
Captain spits on your gold. "We'll take it all." Boarding resumes.

history_note: Pirate tactics favoured night and dawn boarding from boats with muffled oars to achieve surprise (Johnson 1724).

title: The Ransom Note
intro_lines: An arrow lands at your feet.
Tied: a strip of sailcloth, written in charcoal.
"Carpenter lives. Bring 200 gold, 10 powder, map fragment.

choices.label: Pay the ransom in full

outcomes.text: Carpenter returned unharmed, shaking. "They argued about keeping me."
He's alive but maimed — hand crushed. Building speed halved.
Double-cross. They take goods, leave a corpse. Ambush follows.

choices.label: Tide-Puck tracks them — rescue

outcomes.text: Silent as tide. Carpenter freed, pirates none the wiser. You vanish.
Guard dog barks. Fight erupts. Carpenter stabbed in the scramble.
Tide-Puck corners a pirate — it's the carpenter, turned. He betrays you.

choices.label: Assault their camp at dawn — no quarter

outcomes.text: Cannon and musket shatter their tents. Carpenter rescued, pirates scattered.
They used the carpenter as a shield. He dies in the first volley.
Trap. Their main force waits inland. You're pinned on the beach.

history_note: Pirates took hostages for ransom — Roberts used a captured master to identify the richest Portuguese ship (Johnson 1724).

title: The Rat in the Hold
intro_lines: Your best cutlass goes missing.
Then the powder measure.
A sailor swears he saw a monkey.

choices.label: Set a trap — marked coins

outcomes.text: Next dawn, the cook's pockets jingle. He cracks fast — UTC and pirates.
The bait's gone. No one confesses. Paranoia spreads.
Trap springs wrong — innocent sailor framed. Real spy watches, amused.

choices.label: Feed them false intel — leak a fake

outcomes.text: Pirates hit the decoy. Ambush waits. Two captured, one talks.
They smell the trap. Burn the decoy site. Your spy survives.
UTC patrol hits the site instead. Three-way firefight. Chaos.

choices.label: Tide-Puck hunts the scent trail

outcomes.text: Trail leads to a sea cave. Spy's satchel: UTC cipher, pirate signals.
Spy ambushes Tide-Puck. Poisoned dart. Your companion sickens.
Trail ends at the tide line. Spy swam to a waiting longboat.

history_note: Deserters gave intelligence to pirates — a deserter told Roberts how HMS *Swallow* sailed best (Johnson 1724).

title: Press-Ganged
intro_lines: Dawn raid.
They don't want gold — they want your carpenter.
Grappling hooks on the palisade. "I built these walls.

choices.label: Hide the carpenter, fight the boarders

outcomes.text: Carpenter secreted in a root cellar. Boarders repulsed, cursing.
A pirate finds the hatch. Carpenter fights, takes a cutlass blow.
Overrun. Carpenter dragged off screaming. Walls breached.

choices.label: Let him go — negotiate a trade

outcomes.text: Captain accepts. Carpenter returns with a pirate's grin — and a spy's cipher.
They take the goods and the carpenter. "Changed our minds."
Carpenter refuses to leave. "They need me. I'll sabotage from inside."

choices.label: Tide-Puck creates a diversion

outcomes.text: Beast harries the boarders. Carpenter vanishes into the green. Safe.
Pirate bosun shoots Tide-Puck. Carpenter stays, tends the wound.
Carpenter trips in the roots. Pirates grab him. Tide-Puck howls.

history_note: Pirates recruited — or forced — skilled men: carpenters, surgeons, coopers (Johnson 1724).

title: Channel Ambush
intro_lines: You pursue the pirates — or they lure you.
Walls of coral close in.
Ahead, a hulk lies scuttled across the fairway.

choices.label: Full sail — ram the blockship, board

outcomes.text: Splinters fly. You're aboard their flagship. Quartermaster yields.
Impact throws guns loose. Broadside at point-blank shreds your deck.
The carpenter — their carpenter — springs the trap. Powder magazine blows.

choices.label: Anchor off, land parties on the cliffs

outcomes.text: Tide-Puck guides climbers. Guns spiked. Pirates trapped in the channel.
Cliff paths crumble. Two men fall. Guns fire anyway — channel run costly.
Tideborn scouts on the cliffs. They help — for a relic shard.

choices.label: Parley — offer the carpenter's freedom

outcomes.text: Quartermaster agrees. "A fair trade." Carpenter returned, you sail free.
They take the gold. Carpenter walks the plank. "Nothing personal."
The carpenter stabs the quartermaster. Chaos. You flee in the confusion.

history_note: Pirates ambushed in narrow channels and behind headlands (Johnson 1724).

title: Dawn Landing
intro_lines: First light.
Five longboats grind onto the sand, bows high.
Pirates wade ashore in shirtsleeves. "This beach is ours."

choices.label: Hold the palisade, volley fire by ranks

outcomes.text: Disciplined fire breaks the first wave. Captain falls. They retreat.
They reach the logs. Melee at the gate. Your carpenter holds it shut.
Powder damp from sea air. Click. Click. They pour over laughing.

choices.label: Fallback to the jungle — let them burn

outcomes.text: They loot, burn, leave. You return to ashes — but lives saved.
Scouts track your trail. Skirmish in the ferns. Losses on both sides.
Tideborn appear, drive pirates off. Demand a toll for the favour.

choices.label: Challenge the captain to single combat

outcomes.text: You disarm him. His crew honours the code. They sail at sunset.
He cheats — hidden dagger. You bleed. Crew intervenes, drags him off.
His quartermaster shoots you mid-duel. "Captain's orders." They swarm.

history_note: Pirate tactics favoured dawn boarding from boats to achieve surprise (Johnson 1724).

title: The Black Flag Parley
intro_lines: A sloop anchors off the reef.
Black flag.
No shots fired. A boat comes in under white flag.

choices.label: Refuse — fire a warning shot across

outcomes.text: They weigh anchor, cursing. "Your funeral." But they leave.
Warning shot hits a mast. They return fire — heavy guns.
UTC frigate appears on the horizon. Pirates flee. You're saved.

choices.label: Sign the articles — gain a haven, lose

outcomes.text: You swear. Access to pirate havens, fences, careening beaches.
They make you careen their ships first. Months of unpaid labour.
Articles read: "No quarter to UTC." You're now a marked target.

choices.label: Buy them off — tribute for a year's

outcomes.text: Quartermaster signs a chit. "One year. Then we talk again."
He spits. "Tribute's for kings. We'll take it and the island."
Tide-Puck steals the treaty. Quartermaster laughs. "Keep it."

history_note: Pirates used intimidation to make victims strike without a fight — most prizes surrendered (Johnson 1724).

title: Careening Camp Raid
intro_lines: You find a pirate careening camp — ship heeled.
Guns landed in a sand battery.
Crew drunk on turtle and rum. Tide-Puck circles downwind.

choices.label: Burn the careened ship — strike while

outcomes.text: Flames race up the tarred hull. Magazine explodes. Camp destroyed.
Wind shifts. Fire catches your boat. Desperate escape.
Sentry wakes. Raises alarm. You're pinned on the beach by grape.

choices.label: Steal their stores — food, powder

outcomes.text: Silent as crabs. Wagons loaded. Gone before the hangovers clear.
A pirate stumbles out to piss. Spots Tide-Puck. Chase ensues.
The ship's carpenter catches you. He joins your camp instead.

choices.label: Poison their rum — let fever do the work

outcomes.text: Half the crew dead by dawn. The rest sail, cursed. Camp abandoned.
Ship's surgeon identifies it. He tracks you. Antidote demanded.
Tide-Puck eats the bait. Convulsions. You save it — barely.

history_note: Pirate crews were defenceless while careening; guns often landed in a beach battery (JMU thesis).

title: Marooned
intro_lines: Your own crew turns.
Quartermaster reads the articles aloud.
"Defrauding the company. Theft between mates. One pistol.

choices.label: Accept the sentence — walk the plank

outcomes.text: Tide-Puck swims beside you. You reach a cay. Survival begins.
Sharks circle. Tide-Puck drives them off. You climb a wreck's mast.
The quartermaster tosses you a map fragment. "For old times."

choices.label: Challenge the quartermaster — pistol

outcomes.text: Your ball grazes his thigh. He yields. Crew backs you. Mutiny averted.
His shot takes your ear. Cutlass clash — he's faster. You're marooned.
Tide-Puck lunges for his throat. Crew screams "Witchcraft!" Both exiled.

choices.label: Invoke pirate law — demand a jury

outcomes.text: Haven elders arrive. Evidence reviewed. Charges dismissed. Quartermaster fired.
Elders are bribed. Verdict stands. But they give you a better boat.
Tideborn scouts intercept the boat. "The sea people judge now."

history_note: Pirate articles prescribed marooning with a gun, shot, bottle of water, bottle of powder for defrauding the company (Johnson 1724).

title: The Haven's Tithe
intro_lines: A familiar cutter enters the lagoon — the haven's factor.
"The Brethren's share.
Ten percent of all take. Back-tithe for three moons."

choices.label: Pay the tithe — keep the haven's

outcomes.text: Ledger signed. Haven's guns now cover your anchorage. Safe passage.
Factor pockets half. You learn. Leverage for next time.
UTC warship follows the factor in. Haven burns. You're on your own.

choices.label: Refuse — fortify, call in Tideborn

outcomes.text: Walls rise. Tideborn archers man the palisade. Factor leaves, threatening.
Pirate fleet arrives. Siege. You hold, but stores bleed dry.
Factor returns with a royal pardon for your crew. Mutiny brews.

choices.label: Sell the factor to UTC — his ledger

outcomes.text: UTC pays handsomely. Factor vanishes. Haven's economy collapses.
Factor escapes. Warns the Brethren. You're hostis humani generis.
Tideborn intercept the trade. "We know what you did." Relic demanded.

history_note: The haven chain — haven, victualler, receiver, protector — sustained pirate economies (Sailing the Black Flag).

title: The Bribed Protector
intro_lines: A UTC officer in civilian coat asks for gold.
He promises warning of raids if paid.

choices.label: Pay him two gold

outcomes.text: He keeps his word; raiders diverted for a week.
He pockets it and sells your camp's position.

choices.label: Refuse and threaten him

outcomes.text: He flees; your boldness earns haven respect.
He returns with UTC marines at dawn.

history_note: Pirate havens relied on bribed officials as protectors in the haven chain.

title: Sold Out
intro_lines: UTC marines breach the palisade at dawn.
They seek the relic shard cache.

choices.label: Fight from the ramparts

outcomes.text: You drive them off; camp stands scarred.
Overwhelmed; loot taken, fires set.

choices.label: Hide the shard and surrender

outcomes.text: They find nothing; leave with a warning.
They torture a sailor; he reveals it.

history_note: UTC privateers hunted Tideborn relics with dark-binding crystals.

title: A Debt Repaid
intro_lines: The officer returns, wounded, seeking refuge.
He carries a UTC cipher book.

choices.label: Shelter him and read the book

outcomes.text: Intel reveals a UTC convoy route.
He steals rum and slips away at night.

choices.label: Turn him over to free pirates

outcomes.text: They ransom him; you earn a cut.
His kin ambush you on the road.

history_note: Pirate justice included ransom and marooning under articles.

title: Scuttled Barrier
intro_lines: A hulk is towed into the harbour mouth.
It will be sunk to block warships.

choices.label: Help scuttle and salvage

outcomes.text: Timber and iron recovered; harbour safer.
A keel snags your boat; you swim free.

choices.label: Refuse; watch from shore

outcomes.text: You miss salvage but stay dry.
Wreck drifts and crushes your skiff.

history_note: Ships were deliberately sunk as harbour barriers at Ile Sainte-Marie.

title: Fever in the Haven
intro_lines: Sailors fall to fever after a turtle feast.
Quartermaster Silas needs herbs.

choices.label: Send Tide-Puck for herbs

outcomes.text: Fresh herbs found; fever breaks.
Puck returns empty; fever worsens.

choices.label: Quarantine and boil water

outcomes.text: Slow but steady recovery.
Rumour of plague spreads; morale crashes.

history_note: Fever killed most of the Susanna's crew at St Mary's.

title: Recruiting the Carpenter
intro_lines: A skilled carpenter sits drunk on the beach.
Free pirates want him for a careening crew.

choices.label: Buy his debt and free him

outcomes.text: He joins your camp; repairs improve.
He drinks the gold away and vanishes.

choices.label: Let the pirates press him

outcomes.text: He sails off; you gain pirate favour.
He resists; brawl leaves you bruised.

history_note: Pirates recruited skilled men like carpenters and surgeons by force.

title: Pardon Offer
intro_lines: Woodes Rogers' envoy offers the King's pardon.
Sign, and your past debts vanish.

choices.label: Accept the pardon

outcomes.text: You walk free; some pirates shun you.
It's a trap; you're clapped in irons.

choices.label: Refuse and toast the black flag

outcomes.text: Free pirates cheer; haven doors open.
UTC bounty rises; hunters follow.

history_note: Woodes Rogers issued pardons at Nassau in 1718.

title: Locals Rise Over Cattle
intro_lines: Islanders raid the haven for stolen cattle.
Pirates scramble for their guns.

choices.label: Side with the islanders

outcomes.text: Cattle returned; locals share fruit.
Islanders distrust you; stones thrown.

choices.label: Defend the pirate camp

outcomes.text: Islanders routed; plundered stores.
A hut burns; cattle stampede.

history_note: Islanders rose and killed pirates over stolen cattle at Ile Sainte-Marie.

title: Victualler's Price
intro_lines: Victualler sells salt pork at triple price.
His scales look rigged.

choices.label: Pay and keep peace

outcomes.text: Stocked up; no trouble today.
Pork is spoiled; crew sickens.

choices.label: Accuse him of cheating

outcomes.text: Crowd sides with you; fair price.
He draws a knife; you back off.

history_note: Havens depended on victuallers and receivers in the haven chain.

title: Careening Under Guard
intro_lines: Your hull is hauled over on the beach.
Crew is defenceless while scraping.

choices.label: Land guns as beach battery

outcomes.text: Raiders see the guns and withdraw.
A squall floods the battery; delay.

choices.label: Rush the scrape, skip the tar

outcomes.text: Faster careen; hull still sound.
Teredo worms remain; leak at sea.

history_note: Careening left crews defenceless; guns were landed as beach batteries.

title: Condent's Scuttled Dragon
intro_lines: A scuttled frigate lies in the bay.
Locals whisper of hidden powder.

choices.label: Dive the wreck at dawn

outcomes.text: Powder and coin recovered.
Eel bites; you surface gasping.

choices.label: Chart it and sell the map

outcomes.text: Receiver pays well for the chart.
Receiver betrays you to UTC.

history_note: Condent's Fiery Dragon was scuttled in the bay as a pardon condition.

title: The Deserter's Footprints
intro_lines: Fresh prints in the sand — bare feet, dragging one leg.
A cutlass scabbard lies abandoned, salt-rusted.
Tide-Puck bristles, nose low to the wet grains.

choices.label: Track him inland

outcomes.text: You find a lean man drinking from a coconut shell. He raises empty hands — Silas's deserter, 'One-Eye' Malloy. He swears he fled UTC press-gangs, not the articles.
The trail ends at a slit throat. UTC binding crystals glitter in the wound. A patrol finds you kneeling over the body.
Malloy ambushes you from a fig tree. He needs your boat. Tide-Puck's warning saves your throat, but his knife opens your forearm.

choices.label: Burn the trail, warn the outpost

outcomes.text: Silas nods grimly. 'Marooning's too good for deserters.' Posters go up. A week later, Malloy's head on a pike at the reef passage.
The smoke draws a UTC cutter. They land marines, not deserters. Your warning fire becomes their beacon.

history_note: Based on Bartholomew Roberts' articles: desertion meant death or marooning with a gun, shot, bottle of water, and bottle of powder.

title: One-Eye's Ledger
intro_lines: Malloy presses a sodden notebook into your hands.
'UTC convoy routes.
Crystal shipment dates. All of it.'

choices.label: Trust the ledger, raid the convoy

outcomes.text: The convoy appears on schedule. Crates of dark-binding crystals, iron, and rum. Malloy fights beside you, screaming for his lost eye. The haul feeds the camp for weeks.
The convoy's a trap. Warships rise from behind the cay. Malloy shrugs. 'Told 'em you'd come.' UTC marines swarm the beach. You fight free, but the camp burns.
Malloy vanishes in the fight. The crystals are fake — salt painted black. His ledger was a UTC plant. Silas spits on the sand. 'Should've marooned him.'

choices.label: Hand the ledger to Silas

outcomes.text: Silas cross-references with captured UTC logs. The routes match. Malloy earns a share and a grudging nod. The convoy raid is set for the new moon.
Silas burns the book. 'Written in UTC cipher. He's feeding you to the wolves.' Malloy's gone by dawn — took a skiff and the tide.

history_note: Pirates used captured masters to identify richest targets; Roberts used a Portuguese master to pick the richest ship in a fleet.

title: The Leviathan's Wake
intro_lines: The Abyssal Sovereign rises beneath the UTC flotilla.
Crystals scream.
The water boils with bioluminescent rage.

choices.label: Signal Malloy's boat — together we

outcomes.text: Malloy turns his guns on the UTC flagship. His crew boards amid the chaos. You seize a crystal-laden brigantine. He grins, one eye wild. 'Articles hold, Captain.'
Malloy signals the UTC. 'Take them. The crystals are yours.' A grapeshot volley shreds your mainsail. You escape in the leviathan's shadow, but the camp is compromised.

choices.label: Cut Malloy loose — every ship for itself

outcomes.text: You ride the leviathan's wake through the UTC line. Malloy's brig takes the brunt. He goes down screaming. His share sinks with him. Silas drinks to his memory.
The leviathan ignores you. UTC grapples your stern. Malloy watches from his quarterdeck, drinking rum. 'Articles don't apply to ghosts.' You're boarded.

history_note: Pirates fought ashore to settle quarrels — pistol then cutlass, first blood wins. At sea, false flags and intimidation made most prizes surrender without a fight.

title: Quartermaster's Crown
intro_lines: A figure waves from the cliffs of Isle Mourne — marooned.
Quartermaster's coat, salt-bleached.
A pistol at his hip. Tide-Puck whines.

choices.label: Row ashore, hear his tale

outcomes.text: It's 'Silver' Toby, Silas's rival. Marooned for 'theft between mates' — slit ears, nose gone. He knows every careening beach, every UTC patrol route. He wants his articles back.
Toby's mad. Sun, thirst, and the gulls pecking his ears. He fires his last shot at you. The bullet grazes your ribs. You leave him screaming at the tide.
UTC lands a boat as you approach. Toby waves them in. 'Captain! The camp's unguarded!' You row for your life as grapeshot churns the water.

choices.label: Signal from the ship — let Silas decide

outcomes.text: Silas arrives with a cutter. Toby kneels. 'Articles say marooning for theft. I served my sentence.' Silas grants a hearing. Toby joins as a common hand — no quartermaster's share.
Silas orders him keelhauled. 'Articles don't forgive.' Toby drowns begging. The crew watches silent. You gain nothing but a heavier silence at mess.

history_note: Roberts' articles: theft between mates meant slit ears and nose, put ashore somewhere hard. Marooning was standard punishment.

title: Careening at Deadman's Cove
intro_lines: The galleon heels on the careening beach.
Teredo tunnels honeycomb her keel.
Toby directs the shore battery. 'Three guns.

choices.label: Trust Toby's battery plan

outcomes.text: Toby's aim is true. The lead UTC cutter takes a chain-shot through the waterline. The others sheer off. The hull gets scraped, tarred, and tallowed on schedule. Toby earns back his share.
Toby's powder is damp — or sabotaged. The guns sputter. UTC marines swarm the beach. You fight knee-deep in surf, the careening unfinished. The ship leaks badly now.
Toby vanishes mid-fight. The battery's abandoned. You rally the crew, but the delay costs the tide. The ship settles wrong — a plank springs. Weeks of repairs ahead.

choices.label: Take command of the battery yourself

outcomes.text: Tide-Puck spots the boarding boats early. Your first shot dismasts their launch. Toby reappears, cutlass in hand, fighting beside you. 'Knew you had it in you, Captain.'
You hold the line, but a splinter takes your shoulder. Toby drags you behind the gun carriage. 'My turn to lead.' He finishes the fight. The crew whispers you're weak.

history_note: During careening, crews were defenceless; guns often landed in a beach battery. Pirate haunts were chosen for careening beaches and turtling grounds.

title: The Haven's Ledger
intro_lines: Toby slips a folded chart into your hammock.
'Haven accounts.'
UTC receivers, bribed governors, Tideborn relic routes.

choices.label: Burn the ledger — no blackmail in this

outcomes.text: Toby nods, unsurprised. 'Didn't think you would.' He stays, fights at the next raid, takes a musket ball meant for you. Dies cursing the UTC. His share goes to the crew's widows.
The fire draws a tideborn scout. She reads the ash. 'You burn knowledge the UTC would kill for.' She marks your camp — friend, not target. Toby watches, thoughtful.

choices.label: Use the ledger — trade secrets

outcomes.text: You feed false intel to a UTC receiver. A supply ship diverts — powder, iron, medicine. Toby grins. 'Quartermaster's work.' But the receiver escapes, and now UTC knows your hand.
The receiver is a Tideborn agent. She pays in relic shards and a warning: 'The Sovereign wakes. The crystals call it.' Toby vanishes with the real ledger. 'Insurance collected.'
Toby sells the ledger to UTC directly. A week later, a fleet anchors at your haven. He stands on the quarterdeck of the flagship, ears slit, nose gone, wearing a commodore's coat.

history_note: The haven chain: haven, victualler, receiver (fence), protector (bribed officials). Pirates traded intelligence and plunder through this network.

title: Surgeon's Saw
intro_lines: Screams from a jungle cave.
The smell of blood and rum.
A UTC cage holds a man in a bloodstained apron. Clean.

choices.label: Free him, bring him to camp

outcomes.text: Dr. Vane. Forced to serve UTC after his ship was taken. He tends the camp's fevers, saves a sailor's crushed leg with amputation. 'Rum for anaesthetic. Silk for ligatures. I'll need both.'
Vane's hands shake. He botches a simple lancing. The patient dies of gangrene. The crew mutters. Silas puts him to work boiling tar — 'Less harm there.'
Vane poisons the rum barrel. Three dead before Tide-Puck alerts you. He flees into the jungle, but not before stealing the herb stores. UTC patrol finds his trail — and yours.

choices.label: Leave him. UTC problem, not ours.

outcomes.text: A week later, a UTC deserter stumbles into camp. 'Vane saved my life. Then he saved the captain's. They're hunting you with his maps.' The surgeon's skills now serve the enemy.
Tideborn scouts find the cave first. They take Vane — and his knowledge of UTC crystal protocols. A tideborn healer now knows how to counter dark-binding. Your camp gains a quiet ally.

history_note: Pirates forced skilled men — carpenters, surgeons — to join. Deserters gave intelligence; a deserter told Roberts how HMS Swallow sailed best.

title: Boucan & Boarding
intro_lines: Turtle fat sizzles on the boucan frames.
The crew feasts.
Vane carves meat with his amputation saw. Clean cuts.

choices.label: Vane organizes the wounded as a reserve

outcomes.text: Vane's 'lazarus line' — bandaged men with pistols — fires a volley that shatters the first boat. The UTC hesitate. You lead the counter-charge. The beach runs red, but the camp holds.
The wounded break. Vane tries to rally them, takes a ball to the shoulder. His saw goes flying. You drag him back. The UTC gain the beach. The boucan frames burn.
Vane slips away in the smoke. The UTC officer shouts his name — they know each other. The boarding party withdraws with Vane 'captured.' A ransom note arrives by dawn.

choices.label: Fight at the gunwales, Vane tends

outcomes.text: The crew repels the boarding. Vane works through the night — seventeen amputations, zero deaths from shock. 'Clean cuts. Good ligatures. Rum helps.' The crew toasts him.
You're pinned at the mainmast. Vane appears with a boarding axe, not a saw. He kills the UTC lieutenant. 'I swore an oath to do no harm. I amend it.' He stays. The crew stares.

history_note: Camp life: tents of sails, rum, turtle and goat barbecues (boucan), quartermaster as camp judge. Pirates cared for injured per articles — 800 dollars for a limb.

title: The Turtling Moon
intro_lines: Green turtles crawl ashore under the full moon.
Dozens.
Tide-Puck stalks the treeline — crabs, not turtles.

choices.label: Work the beach alone — quiet, all

outcomes.text: You flip six turtles before dawn. Meat, shells, oil. Tide-Puck drives off ghost crabs. A good haul. Your back screams for days.
A tiger shark takes your leg in the shallows. Tide-Puck drags you ashore. You live — barely. The turtles escape. Silas shakes his head. 'Greed bites.'
UTC patrol spots your fires. They don't attack — they wait offshore. You abandon half the catch fleeing. 'Turtling's not worth a hanging,' Silas says.

choices.label: Crew shares the work, crew shares

outcomes.text: Twenty turtles flipped. The camp feasts for a week. Shells become water catchers, bowls, trade goods. Even the UTC patrol watches and rows away — too many witnesses.
A dispute over shares turns bloody. Two crew dead. The turtles rot in the sun. Silas maroons the killer on a cay with a bottle of water. 'Articles hold.'

history_note: Pedro Serrano flipped sea turtles onto their backs to catch them; drank blood when no rain. Turtles nested at night; shells used as vessels.

title: Boucan Betrayal
intro_lines: The boucan smokes.
Rum flows.
Dice click on a sea-chest lid.

choices.label: Challenge him to dice — win his secrets

outcomes.text: You clean him out. His purse holds a UTC cypher wheel and a Tideborn relic map. He flees into the jungle, cursing. Silas burns the cypher. 'Don't need their codes.'
He wins. Your gold, your map fragment, your rum stores. He leaves at dawn, whistling. A week later, UTC hits the camp with exact knowledge of your stores.
Tide-Puck knocks the table over. Crystals spill from the stranger's pocket — dark-binding. He draws a pistol. You draw faster. The boucan goes silent.

choices.label: Feed him poisoned rum — quiet removal

outcomes.text: He drinks, chokes, dies in the latrine. His pack: UTC patrol schedules, a Tideborn scout's death warrant, and a letter — your camp's coordinates. Silas nods. 'Good work.'
He smells the herbs. 'Monkshood? Crude.' He's a UTC surgeon. He doses YOU. You wake bound, the camp burning. Tide-Puck chews your ropes. Vane — if you have him — saves you.

history_note: Pirate camp life: rum, gambling ashore, fights. Quartermaster as camp judge. UTC deployed dark-binding crystals that enrage the leviathan.

title: Careening Ambush
intro_lines: The galleon heels on the beach.
Guns landed.
Hull exposed. Fog swallows the mastheads. They've timed it.

choices.label: Scuttle the longboat — trap them

outcomes.text: The brig grounds on the hidden reef you marked. Your beach battery — rebuilt since last time — rakes her decks. The tide turns. You capture a warship. Silas weeps with joy.
The brig's pilot knows the reef. She threads the needle. Grapeshot scythes the battery. You fight on the careening beach, knee-deep in tar and sand. The galleon burns.
The fog lifts. The Abyssal Sovereign rises under the brig. Crystals scream. The warship splinters. You watch from the beach, tar-stained and alive. The leviathan ignores you.

choices.label: Cut the careening lines — sail damaged

outcomes.text: The galleon rights, sails sheeted home in minutes. You flee into the fog, hull leaking, teredo tunnels open. But you live. The UTC brig fires blind into mist.
A plank springs as you clear the shoals. The pump crew drowns below. You beach her on a hostile coast, limp into the jungle. The UTC lands marines. A long chase begins.

history_note: During careening, crews were defenceless; guns often landed in a beach battery. Pirate haunts chosen for careening beaches. Deserters gave intelligence on patrol routes.
